label: Every email the portal sends

params.name: code_text_signup
params.default:
Your {product} verification code is {code}.

Type it on the sign-up page to confirm this address. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.

If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: nothing happens.

params.name: code_text_reset
params.default:
Somebody asked to reset the password for this address on {product}.

Your code is {code}. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.

If this was not you, ignore this message: your password has not changed.

params.name: invite_subject
params.default: You have been given an account on {product}

params.name: invite_text
params.default:
{who} created an account for you on {product}.

Choose your password here:
{url}

The link works once and expires in {days} days.

params.name: reset_by_owner_text
change_note
params.default: You will be asked to choose your own password when you sign in.

params.name: test_text
params.default:
If you are reading this, {product} can send mail.

Sign-up codes, password resets and invitations will reach people.

params.name: signup_exists_subject
params.default: {product}: somebody tried to sign up with this address

params.name: signup_exists_text
params.default:
Somebody — perhaps you — tried to create an account on {product} with this address, but it already has one.

If it was you, sign in, or use Forgot password on the sign-in page to get a code.

If it was not you, ignore this message: nothing has changed.

description_nl: The words are plain text and the text part is sent exactly as written; since 2026-10-16 core/mailer.py build() adds the site's branded HTML beside it (chip mail.layout, the site file's mail mark / accent). {product}, {code}, {minutes}, {days}, {who}, {url}, {password}, {change_note} fill in.
